landing.heroBadge: Live table availability, in real time
landing.subtitle: See exactly which tables are free — inside, outside, at the bar — and lock yours in seconds. No calls, no waiting.
landing.howTitle: From hungry to seated in three steps
landing.step1Text: See real availability — inside, terrace or bar — before you call.
landing.step2Text: Pick your party, vibe and time. Your table is locked in instantly.
landing.step3Text: Confirmations and reminders straight to your phone.
landing.socializeTitle: Dining alone doesn't mean dining solo.
landing.socializeBody: On the day of your booking, Kamix opens a private room for your restaurant — see who else is dining, make yourself visible, and send a drink or dessert to a fellow table. It's the classic “send a bottle to table 12” moment, without needing to ask.
landing.soc1Text: On the day of your booking, appear in the room and spot other diners around you — or stay invisible if you'd rather.
landing.soc2Text: Surprise a fellow diner with a gift from the restaurant's catalog. It's charged to your bill — a toast from across the room.
landing.soc3Text: Deliver the news instantly, or keep it a secret surprise until the restaurant brings it to their table.
landing.socializeCta: Try Socialize on your next booking
landing.ownersBody: Set your sections, hours and menus once. Walk-ins, callers and app bookings all draw from the same availability — never oversell a table.
